lines.text: It’s project time! Make two pets talk in ScratchJr, taking turns with waits, and add a looks surprise.
Each pet says at least two things.
Use waits so they take turns.
Add a grow, shrink, hide or show for a funny surprise.
Press the green flag and show your scene to a friend.
The puppy says “Watch this!”, grows, says “I’m big!”, then walks to the star.
Ta-da! A big puppy with big news.
Great work! Let’s remember what we learned.
Now plan it, build it, test it, and share it!
